picks.file: Veduta d'Atene da Mezzo Giorno - Coronelli Vincenzo - 1686.jpg
picks.what: Athens from the south, engraving in Coronelli’s Repubblica di Venezia
picks.why: labeled view; Acropolis with the Parthenon as a mosque, Areopagus and the Olympieion columns

picks.file: A panoramic view of the Acropolis from west in 1751.jpg
picks.what: The Acropolis from the west, colored engraving in Stuart and Revett, The Antiquities of Athens, vol. 2
picks.why: color, high resolution; Acropolis with the Frankish tower, Lycabettus behind

picks.file: View of Athens from the river Ilissos - J. M. Wittmer (1833).jpg
picks.what: Athens from the Ilissos, with the Olympieion, Hadrian’s Arch and the Acropolis, painting (Benaki Museum)
picks.why: color general view of the town at independence, main monuments all recognizable

picks.what: Panorama with the Acropolis, Lycabettus and the Observatory, photochrom print (Library of Congress)
picks.why: whole-city panorama at very high resolution; faint stain in the sky at left

picks.what: Aerial photograph of the Acropolis and the city (ETH Library, Zurich)
picks.why: oblique aerial, Parthenon and Panathenaic Stadium clear; trimmed to remove the wing shadow at lower left

picks.file: Panorama of Athens from the area of the National Observatory of Athens. In the distance the Acropolis of Athens and Mount Lycabettus.jpg
picks.what: The Acropolis and Lycabettus from the Observatory hill, photograph
picks.why: recent general view, same viewpoint as the 1890s photochrom; Acropolis small at right

gaps: P0 and P1: no usable candidates (#1 is a Nuremberg Chronicle portrait of Aristides, #2 a 20th-century photo misdated 1206).
notes: #14: Commons dates it 1751, when Stuart drew it; the plate was first published in vol. 2 of The Antiquities of Athens (title page 1787, issued about 1790), so dated 1787. #11 is the uncolored engraving of the same plate, misdated 1762. #12 (Tower of the Winds, vol. 1, 1762) is an alternative for P3. #5 and #4 (Coronelli) show the 1687 bombardment of the Acropolis, and #8 (Fanelli 1695) is the bombardment too; not used. #7 (Gaignières drawing, Athens from the southeast) is a fine panorama but dated only ‘17th century’. #17 (Athens over the rooftops to the Acropolis, 1890s) has the better composition for P4 but is only 1024 px. #27: Commons category says 1934 but the file is from the 1929–30 Kilimanjaro flight; date field 1930. #33 is Athens, Georgia (excluded).
